english.title: Football spectator using false document for exemption
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in connection with an application under Section 20 of the Football Spectators Act 1989 for exemption from the requirements imposed by or under the Act or in respect of any regulated football match to which the application relates, produced, furnished, signed or otherwise made use of a document which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular or recklessly produced, furnished, signed or otherwise made use of a document which was false or misleading in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(10)(b) and (11) of the Football Spectators Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
produces, furnishes, signs or otherwise makes use of a document
which he knows to be false or misleading in a material particular, or
recklessly produces, furnishes, signs or otherwise makes use of a document
which is false or misleading in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This wording applies ONLY to Banning Orders as introduced by the Football (Disorder) Act 2000 which combines domestic and international football banning orders.
(iii) H4271 remains valid until the end of the expiry period for International Banning Order introduced under the Football (Offences and Disorder) Act 1999 which may run depending on the original offence as follows:-
(a) from 27/9/99 - 27/8/2010: maximum 10 years where offence imprisonable
(b) from 27/9/99 - 27/8/2005: maximum 5 years where offence non-imprisonable
(iii) See the Football Spectators (Prescription) Order 2000, SI 2126/2000 for a definition of a 'regulated' football match which covers certain association football matches and international matches.
(iv) Now PNC recordable from 18/08/07 as per S.I. 2007/2121

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
